note: _architriclinus_ – head stewart, Speisemeister, a word that transliterates Greek ἀρχιτρίκλινος. Used only here in the Vulgate, it is a rare word in Latin. Jerome, though, uses it in his _Commentary on Isaiah_ I on Isa 1:22 with reference to the Johannine passage (PL 24 [1863]: 39). Cf. Theodore A. Bergren: Greek Loanwords in the Vulgate New Testament and the Latin Apostolic Fathers. _Traditio_ 74 (2019) 1–25, at p. 17.

Mayara Nogueira Xavier: O latim da Vulgata e de outras traduções bíblicas em língua Latina. _Língua, Literatura e Ensino_ 5 (2010) 219–227. – This paper, in Portuguese, offers a comparison of the Vulgate version of this verse with two Vetus-Latina renderings.
